test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_top_k_text_index ( key UInt64, ts DateTime, message String, INDEX idx_message message TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY key SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_top_k_text_index SELECT number, toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + cityHash64(number, 1) % 31536000, concat( 'level=', multiIf(cityHash64(number, 2) % 10 < 7, 'info', cityHash64(number, 2) % 10 < 9, 'warn', 'error'), ' method=', multiIf(cityHash64(number, 3) % 10 < 5, 'get', cityHash64(number, 3) % 10 < 8, 'post', 'put'), ' status=', toString([200, 201, 204, 400, 404, 500, 502, 503][cityHash64(number, 4) % 8 + 1]), ' user=', toString(cityHash64(number, 5) % 10000), ' latency_ms=', toString(cityHash64(number, 6) % 5000), if(cityHash64(number, 7) % 1000 = 0, ' upstream timeout', '')) FROM numbers(50000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT key, ts, message FROM t_top_k_text_index WHERE hasToken(message, 'get') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT key, ts, message FROM t_top_k_text_index WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['get', 'post']) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT key, ts, message FROM t_top_k_text_index WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['warn', 'error']) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT key, ts, message FROM t_top_k_text_index WHERE hasToken(message, 'get') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS text_index_posting_list_apply_mode = 'materialize'
SELECT key, ts, message FROM t_top_k_text_index WHERE hasToken(message, 'timeout') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10
